thread:
Carmen: Quick kickoff 10k "mini-benchmark" webinar next week. Need a social push across X + LinkedIn and a small paid boost plan if organic underperforms. Deliverables: 1) X single-image + 2 caption tones, 2) LinkedIn long post + carousel, 3) 15s clip for stories, 4) DM follow-up template for registrants. Also need lead-routing with unique tag + UTMs. Who can own creative? @Leo?

Leo: I can do the image + story clip. Drop final toplines and any PM quote. Prefer exports: PNG (1200x1200) + MP4 (1080x1080).

Ivy: Toplines + quote in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/minibench_may. Top stats: ~50% latency reduction, 2.0x throughput, ~28% cost savings. PM quote short: "Cut tail latency and costs without sacrificing quality."

Carmen: Routing: tag leads `minibench_may` and route to `webinar-sdr-rotation`. UTMs: utm_campaign=minibench_may&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic, set utm_content to `x_image`/`li_carousel`/`story_clip`. @Tom can you add the rule + a staging test?

Tom: On it. Will create rule and run a staging test. Also add `ref=minibench_may` as a prefill param. I'll post test results here.

UTM-bot: Suggested publish windows: Mon 11:00 PT, Tue 09:00 PT, Wed 10:30 PT. Console slots available.

Leo: Creative notes: will include a subtle methodology ribbon on the carousel and two alt colorways. ETA Wed 3pm PT. I'll upload both PNG sets and the MP4.

Ivy: Copy guidance: For X we A/B test tone: (A) benefit-led punchy, (B) technical-first. For LinkedIn, use narrative + PM quote + CTA. DM follow-up should be short and include a link + 1-line value prop. I'll draft copy variants.

Carmen: Also craft a short paid-boost plan: boost the best-performing X variation with $200/day for 2 days if CTR < 1.0% in first 24h. Keep geo target US + UK, interest: platform engineers, PMs.

Tom: Staging routing test completed at 14:07 PT 1 sample lead with tag `minibench_may` landed in `webinar-sdr-rotation-staging` and utm params intact.

Leo: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/edits/minibench_assets.zip  includes alt colorways + story clip.

Ivy: Draft captions and LinkedIn copy posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/copy/minibench_captions.md. Two X variants + LinkedIn long-form + DM template included.

Promo-bot: Reminder: schedule slot reserved Mon 11:00 PT for initial publish. Use Console -> Scheduling to enqueue.

Carmen: Decision checklist before scheduling: 1) choose primary X caption (A or B), 2) choose carousel colorway (A/B), 3) confirm short link redirect and GA event, 4) DM template final. Propose publish X variant A (benefit-led) first, carousel colorway B.

Ivy: Agreed. I'll make a minor stat phrasing tweak: use "~50%" to reflect sample size. DM template tweak done.

Tom: Prod smoke test plan: after publish, send a test registration through short link and confirm lead appears in `webinar-sdr-rotation` with correct UTMs and `ref` param. I'll run and report back.

Leo: Small creative ask  can we add caption overlay on slide 2 of carousel for readability? Uploaded v2 with darker overlay.

Carmen: Good call. Use v2. Also pin fallback plan: if 24h CTR < 1.0% flip CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin carousel + run paid boost on winning variant, escalate to $300/day if CTR still low after boost 24h.

Tom: Scheduling smoke test completed after publish at 11:08 PT  test registration landed in `webinar-sdr-rotation` with utm_campaign=minibench_may and utm_content=x_image. All good.

Promo-bot: Scheduling job queued: Tue 09:00 PT reserved for LinkedIn carousel.

Ivy: I'll monitor engagement metrics first 24h and post updates here. Also prepared two engagement follow-up DMs for SDRs: (1) "Thanks for registering, heres the quick on-demand link" and (2) "Missed it? Schedule a 1:1 demo".

Carmen: Perfect. One more: add a small experiment tag on posts for UTM `exp=carousel_alt` for the LinkedIn variant so we can track creative A/B uplift.

Tom: Added `exp=carousel_alt` to the LinkedIn scheduled post.

Ivy: Monitoring started. If organic engagement low, we flip CTA and kick paid boost per plan. Will post results after 24h window.

Carmen: Thanks team  closing thread once morning smoke test passes and posts are queued. Great job!
